request.text: I want an upgrade/enhancement/invention that allows my spark rig to shoot at more than one enemy at once

reasons.message: Multi-target firing has no representation in contract.v1 stats (damageMult, fireRateMult, rangeMult, moveSpeedMult, panTickMult, maxHpBonus). A chain/fork/pierce or target-count delta is required and does not exist in this epoch contract; the Assayer must not stretch vocabulary to fake it.

contractVerdict.summary: M5-01 contract gate: requested capability (hit more than one enemy at once) cannot be expressed by any contract.v1 stat delta. Reject rather than stretch vocabulary.
